title: ClipAnalysis
description: One analyzed engagement. `measured` is written only by the local CV pipeline; `assessed` is written only by the AI model. Authored to the intersection of Gemini response_schema, OpenAI strict json_schema, and Anthropic tool input_schema: every property is required, additionalProperties is false everywhere, optionality is expressed as a nullable type union, and there is no top-level oneOf.

session_id.description: UUIDv4 grouping all clips from one source recording.

start_ms.description: Clip start offset within the source recording.

content_sha256.description: Hash of the trimmed clip bytes. Participates in the AI response cache key.

detected_by.description: Which CV detectors fired. Lets you audit an event back to its evidence.

measured.description: Deterministic output of the local CV pipeline. GROUND TRUTH. The AI model is instructed never to recompute or contradict these.

reaction_time_ms.description: Stimulus onset to first shot. Null when no stimulus onset could be localized.

reaction_time_error_ms.description: Half-frame-interval uncertainty, e.g. 16.7 at 60fps. Always render alongside the value.

smoothness_sparc.description: Spectral arc length of the angular velocity profile. Less negative is smoother. Amplitude- and duration-normalized, so flicks and tracks are comparable.

jitter_ratio.description: Fraction of velocity PSD energy above jitter_band_hz[0]. Voluntary aim is under ~5 Hz; energy above 8 Hz is tremor, grip tension, or sensor noise.

overshoot_count.description: Velocity sign changes in the 150 ms preceding the shot.

crosshair_placement_method.description: Recorded so rows produced by different pipeline versions stay comparable in trend charts.

target_switch_ms.description: Kill A to crosshair settled on target B, where settled = |omega| < 15 deg/s for 3 consecutive frames.

path_efficiency.description: Ideal angular distance divided by actual path length. 1.0 is a perfect direct flick.

trace.description: Parallel arrays, not an array of objects: ~4x smaller on disk and feeds uPlot without a transform. All four arrays share a length.

cv_warnings.description: Human-readable caveats surfaced in the UI, e.g. low fps limiting reaction-time resolution.

assessed.description: Written only by the AI model. This is the object passed as the response schema / tool input_schema to the provider.

primary_weakness.description: Single highest-leverage correction. A closed enum, not free text, so it can be aggregated across a session.

confidence.description: The model's own confidence given the visual evidence. Low values should co-occur with entries in not_determinable.

summary.description: Two sentences maximum, each citing a tile timestamp.

t_rel_s.description: Seconds from clip start, matching a timestamp burned into a frame-grid tile.

target.description: Must contain a concrete number: sets, minutes, or a metric threshold.

rationale.description: Ties the drill to this clip's specific measured failure.

not_determinable.description: Things the frames could not settle. Giving the model a legitimate place to say 'I could not tell' measurably reduces confabulation.

provenance.description: Cost, model, and rubric version. prompt_version participates in the cache key so improving a prompt invalidates stale analyses instead of mixing two rubrics in one dashboard.

prompt_version.description: Null when the clip never reached the AI tier. The local pipeline is designed to run with no key configured, so a record with no prompt version is a normal outcome, not a missing field.
